generation_rule: Generate the literal product of paths, energy, distinctions, order, orientation, prediction, record and extension forms; decide all 256 candidates only from admitted exact energy, entropy, observation, reaction-direction and equilibrium laws.
grammar_boundary: Every finite pair of forward/reverse reaction path accounts on one held boundary and condition, ordered only by exact positive retained-energy and closed-distinction support, with common-successor closure. External testing retains every finite common NIST-JANAF NO2/N2O4 gas row and every direction.
